findings.description: List retrieved on retry with the project User-Agent (HTTP success, real faculty tables, 365360 bytes). The earlier generic-UA responses were Cloudflare block pages; they are kept in raw/ and are not cited.

Full enumeration: five tables (Primary 30, Emeritus 5, Joint 14, Affiliated 8, Secondary 5) = 62 rows. All 62 brief names appear on the page and no extra names appear, so no omission in either direction.

Profile pages fetched for 26 people (Joint, Affiliated, Secondary, and two Primary-table titles needing checks). Mark Bendett, John Elias and Sean Wang have no profile link in the list, and Charles Ih and David Mills (emeritus) have none either; their decisions rest on the list row. Primary regular rows were decided from the list title alone.

No courtesy designation, incoming status, or start date was found on any fetched page, so every effective_from_json is null and no included record is incoming. Joint and Secondary subtype is not stated, so those are joint_secondary, not regular or courtesy.

Primary-table title 'Professor of Practice' could be read as a professorial rank (regular) under the Primary-table rule. Excluded as teaching because the official ECE profile labels him 'Instructor' and describes a teaching role, which the policy's specific-appointment-type precedence favors. Reviewer should confirm this reading.

Primary-table title 'Research Professor' could be read as a professorial rank (regular). Excluded as research_only because the official ECE profile states a research-professor appointment and the policy excludes research_only. Reviewer should confirm; if research-only professorial titles should count as regular, this record would change to included.

'Entrepreneur in Residence, ECE' in the Affiliated table. The included category in_residence has no defining rule in category_rules. Excluded as generic affiliate because no professorial rank is shown, but a reviewer should confirm whether in_residence was meant to cover this title.
Affiliated table row shows only affiliation 'Apple' with no rank and no profile link. Excluded as generic affiliate because the professorial rank required for affiliate_professor is not established.
Included as affiliate_professor on the listing alone: title 'Professor, Entrepreneur in Residence' in the Affiliated table, with no profile link to corroborate it.

Included as joint_secondary. The CIS profile title is an endowed professorship (Daniel L. Chester Mid-Career Professorship), which is a professorial title. An undated bio still says Assistant Professor, but the more specific current title takes precedence.

Included as joint_secondary. The ME profile header says 'Professor', while the undated bio text says 'Assistant Professor'. The header is the specific current title and takes precedence; either rank is professorial, so the count is unchanged.
